FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Canvas Studio specializes in providing high-quality graphic design and commercial art services, focusing primarily on digital deliverables such as branding, logo design, and web graphics. Operating from a home office, we ensure an efficient workflow, using only licensed software and up-to-date technology to create engaging visual content for our clients. Our small team, consisting of fewer than 5 employees, maintains clear roles and responsibilities to uphold a high standard of service. We pride ourselves on our strong relationships with local small businesses, startups, and non-profits, offering tailored design solutions. All client interactions are conducted virtually, enhancing convenience while safeguarding both client and company data with strict cybersecurity protocols and routine backups. Our documented contracts outline deliverables, timelines, and payment terms to reduce errors and ensure client satisfaction.
